$comment: CANONICAL CoachEasier Core production deployment rules.
This file is the single source of truth for what production is NOT allowed to
contain. It is deliberately data, not code: every rule here must be readable
and challengeable by a human without opening a .mjs file.
THE PRODUCTION MODEL, in one sentence: production is the feature branch minus
the commits listed in `exclusions`. It is NOT a file strip list — the file
differences people used to copy by hand are simply what those commits touched.
Edited by a human only. scripts/deploy-*.mjs read it and FAIL CLOSED when the
repository does not match what is declared here.

exclusions.subject: feat: mount the Tactics Board as a coach section
exclusions.purpose: Tactics Board is a separate product with its own repository and release cycle. It is not part of the Core Beta product and must never reach Core production.
accountsFor: .vercelignore: the `!/tactics` allowlist line (its absence is what makes /tactics/tactics-board.mjs return 404)
index.html: the Tactics mount block, the coach-tactics section and the tactics nav entry (~88 lines)
test/core-beta-nav.test.js, test/structure-admin-ui.test.js, test/season-statistics-view.test.js: their tactics nav assertions

exclusions.subject: feat: add scoped club export for AI CEO
exclusions.purpose: The scoped club export exists for a future AI CEO integration that is not live. It adds a read endpoint to a production API surface for no current product benefit, so it stays out of production until that integration is approved.
accountsFor: api/availability.js: the ?view=club-export branch and its method guard (~32 lines)

exclusions.subject: chore(deploy): record core-deploy-84 as the verified production branch
exclusions.purpose: Superseded bookkeeping. Its only content (lastVerifiedAgainst 82 -> 84) already reached production inside 65326e14, and the stamp has since moved on to core-deploy-88 on both branches, so re-applying it would REVERT lastVerifiedAgainst to an older release. It can never be proven live by the tree check, so without this entry it blocks every future release as AMBIGUOUS. It must never ship.
accountsFor: config/production-exclusions.json: the lastVerifiedAgainst block moving from core-deploy-82 to core-deploy-84 (6 lines)

tactics.rule: Core production must contain no tactics/ files, no Tactics mount or nav in index.html, and no `!/tactics` line in .vercelignore.
tactics.verify: /tactics/tactics-board.mjs must return HTTP 404 on production after every deploy.

clubExport.rule: Core production must contain no api/_clubExport*.js files and no club-export branch in api/availability.js.
clubExport.verify: api/ must be byte-identical to the previous production branch unless an API change was explicitly approved for this release.

performance.rule: performance/ is a VERBATIM MIRROR of the canonical Performance Intelligence repository — the subset Core physically serves, because index.html loads ./performance/... as same-origin ES modules and a sibling repository is not servable. It is no longer legacy shell code. A deploy must never introduce performance/ changes as a SIDE EFFECT: the directory must be byte-identical to the previous production branch unless a performance change is the explicit, approved purpose of the release, declared in `approvedChange` below.
performance.sourceOfTruth: ~/Developer/active/CoachEasier-Performance-Intelligence — fixes are made THERE and re-copied. A fix made in Core is a fork.
performance.coreOwnedException: performance/services/workout-runtime.js is Core's own composition barrel for index.html's dynamic import. Every other file is a verbatim copy.

approvedChange.purpose: SC9.35-SC9.37. Replace Core's pre-Gate-2 copy of the engine with the canonical one, route both generation paths through performance/engine.js, and give an athlete their own programme.
approvedChange.closes: The knownOpenFinding recorded against this policy: index.html perfGenerateDraft() reached Core's pre-Gate-2 copy of the engine, which had no restriction pathway. It now calls performance/engine.js and the pre-Gate-2 chain is not reachable from any live route.
approvedChange.note: This approval is PINNED to the release branch named above. It does not carry forward: the next release re-arms the byte-identical rule automatically, and shipping performance/ again needs a new, deliberate entry here.

apiFunctionCap.rule: Vercel Hobby allows at most 12 non-underscore .js files in api/. We sit at exactly 12. Adding one makes EVERY production deploy fail. Fold new server logic into an existing handler plus a vercel.json rewrite.

missionControl.rule: api/mission-control.js must be zero-diff against the previous production branch in every release.

secrets.rule: No hardcoded credentials in shipped files.

coreIntelligenceBoundary.rule: Core must keep working with every AI service offline. api/*.js must not reference the executive/consciousness/command-centre layers.
coreIntelligenceBoundary.note: index.html carries one long-standing pre-existing match that predates this gate and is NOT introduced by any release; index.html is therefore not scanned here.

baselineRelativeTesting.rule: The suite is NOT zero-failure on production and pretending otherwise would make the gate meaningless. The gate runs the full suite on the previous production branch (in a throwaway git worktree) and on the candidate, then blocks only on failures the candidate INTRODUCES.

knownBaselineFailures.test: composes a full deterministic traveller twin
knownBaselineFailures.cause: Unpinned clock in a travel-platform fixture; red since July 2026. Unrelated to CoachEasier.

retired.test: permissions, navigation and group isolation are unchanged
retired.was: Asserted BETA_NAV_IDS contains "tactics". The tactics-mount commit never touched this file, so excluding that commit left an assertion that contradicted production's stripped nav, and it failed on EVERY production branch by construction.
retired.status: FIXED. The nav is now asserted as a contract — the nine Core Beta sections in order, plus "tactics" if and only if the Tactics section is mounted in the same file — so it is correct on both the development branch and every release branch. Kept here as the record of why a permanently-red test was tolerated, and of the shape to avoid: a test written after a mounted-but-excluded feature cannot be reverted by that feature's exclusion.

baselineRelativeTesting.warning: Never delete or weaken a test to make this gate pass. If a NEW failure appears, fix the cause or abandon the release.
baselineRelativeTesting.note: knownBaselineFailures is DOCUMENTATION, not an input: no script reads it. The gate runs the suite on both branches and derives known / fixed / new from the actual results, so a fixed test is reported as "this release FIXES a previously failing test" whether or not it is listed here. Keep the list true so a human reading it learns what the gate is carrying.

aliases.rule: Three hostnames serve production. Two follow a deploy automatically; the legacy one does not and must be re-pointed on every release.
aliases.note: This domain was manually alias-pinned in May 2026. It was found stale on an old build during the 1718a90 release; deploy:release now re-points and verifies it every time.

deployment.prerequisite: Vercel CLI must be installed and logged in. GitHub auto-deploy has been broken since 2026-06-06; every release is manual.
deployment.neverAutomatic: No script in this repository may deploy without an explicit human-run `npm run deploy:release`.
